title: Apple announces improvements to Liquid Glass, including a new slider that lets users control transparency, ranging from fully opaque to completely clear (Hartley Charlton/MacRumors)
summary: Hartley Charlton / MacRumors: Apple announces improvements to Liquid Glass, including a new slider that lets users control transparency, ranging from fully opaque to completely clear — Apple today announced a series of improvements to Liquid Glass, the translucent design language the company introduced last year.
